title: Ice Cream Pizza
description: Perfect for any type of party, this ice cream "pizza" topped with vanilla ice cream, walnuts, and hot fudge sauce sits atop a chocolate cookie crust.
ingredients: 0.5 (15.25 ounce) package devil's food cake mix
1 quart vanilla ice cream, softened at room temperature for 20 minutes
0.5 cup chopped walnuts, or more to taste
0.33333334326744 cup hot fudge, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Make the crust: Mix cake mix, oil, and egg together in a large bowl until well blended. Fold in chocolate chips. Pour mixture into the center of the prepared baking sheet, and use your fingers to form it into a 1/4-inch thick circle, about 9 inches in diameter. Sprinkle with flaked salt.
Bake in the preheated oven until set, 14 to 16 minutes.

Remove from the oven and firmly knock the bottom of the baking sheet on the counter to remove any extra air from crust. Let cool on the baking sheet for at least 30 minutes. Transfer to a large plate or platter.
Beat softened ice cream in a bowl with an electric mixer until consistency is similar to soft serve.
Use an offset spatula or knife to spread ice cream over cooled crust. Place into the freezer until firm, about 30 minutes.
Slice "pizza" into 8 slices. Top each slice with walnuts and hot fudge.

video.description: While you may know pizza’s good to eat any time, you may not have grabbed a slice for dessert . . . until now! After creating a chocolaty crust with devil’s food cake mix, egg, oil, chocolate chips and a touch of flake salt, spread on a thick “sauce” of vanilla ice cream. Then make it your own and go wild with toppings: hot fudge, salted caramel, raspberry sauce, chopped nuts, candy-coated chocolates, crushed toffee bars and sandwich cookies, chopped peanut butter cups and more!
